'''Flat-sculp''' was a form of painting that was practiced on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Practitioners of flat-sculp painted sheets of sculp (translucent paper) and stacked a number of sheets atop each other.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
